label_provenance: Synthetic questions authored by a separate coding agent after reading the implemented app and sample documents. These are not human-expert labels, customer traffic, or evidence of LLM answer accuracy. The held_out subset was authored after implementation and its labels are not tuned to observed results. The held_out failures were subsequently inspected during implementation fixes; final results are diagnostic, not a blind generalization estimate.
status_definition: evidence_found requests useful source excerpts, not a correct generated answer. needs_review requests abstention when the requested fact is absent. Expected documents and text fragments check retrieval usefulness only.
execution: Fresh temporary SQLite database per case; FastAPI TestClient; model disabled. No network or real model calls.

metric_definitions.required_document_checks_passed: Legacy count over all cases, including vacuous passes where expected_docs is empty; not retrieval accuracy.
metric_definitions.required_document_hits: Cases with nonempty expected_docs where every required document is retrieved; denominator is labeled_retrieval_cases.
metric_definitions.expected_gold_document_ids: Sum of distinct expected document IDs within each labeled case; the same document in different cases is counted separately.
metric_definitions.matched_gold_document_ids: Expected document IDs found in each case, summed across labeled cases; measures source recall only, not relevance of extra sources.
metric_definitions.checked_quotes: Number of returned source excerpts checked against current stored document ID, version, paragraph ID, and exact paragraph text.
metric_definitions.quotes_matching_current_documents: Returned excerpts whose cited ID/version and exact text match the original stored paragraph; does not assess answer usefulness.

generated_answer_accuracy: N/A: model disabled; citation equality is not generated answer accuracy.
limitations: Agent-authored synthetic labels are not a human evaluation or a production benchmark.
A matching status and excerpt do not establish answer correctness or exhaustive retrieval.
Expected empty document lists impose no source constraint; absent facts are assessed by status.
Latency is one local run, includes TestClient and persistence overhead, and is not a service SLA.
Injection cases cover known patterns only; they do not certify adversarial robustness.

cases.question: How do I rotate an API key?
expected_text: Verify a successful request with the new key before revoking the old key.

observed_sources.text: To rotate an API key, open Settings > API keys, select Create key, and copy the new key into your integration. Verify a successful request with the new key before revoking the old key. Only workspace administrators can create or revoke API keys.
A 401 Unauthorized response means the API key is missing, invalid, or revoked. Send the current key in the Authorization: Bearer header. Check that your integration uses the correct workspace key.

cases.question: What does a 401 Unauthorized response mean?

cases.question: What is the API rate limit?

observed_sources.text: The API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per workspace. A 429 response includes a Retry-After header in seconds. Wait for that interval before retrying. Repeated retries during the interval also count toward the limit.

cases.question: How long do export download links last?

observed_sources.text: Workspace administrators can export tickets and contacts from Settings > Data > Export. The export is a CSV archive. Download links expire after 24 hours. Export your data before closing the workspace.

cases.question: How do I set up SAML single sign-on?

observed_sources.text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Business plan. An administrator adds the identity provider metadata in Settings > Security > SSO. Test sign-in with a second administrator before enforcing SSO for all members.

cases.question: Can Viewers edit tickets?
expected_text: Viewers can read tickets but cannot edit them.

observed_sources.text: An administrator can invite team members from Settings > Members by entering their work email address. The available roles are Administrator, Agent, and Viewer. Viewers can read tickets but cannot edit them.

cases.question: How do I change the billing email address?
expected_text: Previously issued invoices are not changed automatically.

observed_sources.text: The workspace owner can change the billing email address in Settings > Billing > Billing contact. New invoices use the updated address. Previously issued invoices are not changed automatically.

cases.question: What are the standard support hours?

observed_sources.text: Standard support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC, excluding published holidays. For an urgent service outage, open a ticket with severity Urgent and include the workspace ID, timestamps, and affected operation. This guide does not promise a resolution time.

cases.question: How many rows can an import CSV file contain?

observed_sources.text: Administrators can import contacts from Settings > Data > Import using a UTF-8 CSV file. The required columns are email and name. Each file can contain at most 5000 rows. Rows with an invalid email are rejected and included in the import error report.

cases.question: How do I verify webhook signatures?

observed_sources.text: HarborDesk signs webhook requests using HMAC-SHA256 in the X-Harbor-Signature header. Verify the signature against the raw request body with your webhook secret. Failed webhook deliveries are retried up to 3 times over 15 minutes. Use the event ID to avoid processing a duplicate event.
